SELECT HS_CODE , HS_CODE_NAME , HS_CODE_DESC , PARENT_HS_CODE FROM HS_CODE WHERE DELETE_YN ='N'
AND HS_CODE LIKE CONCAT(#{searchHsCode}, '%')
ORDER BY HS_CODE

SELECT DISTINCT HC.HS_CODE , FR.HS_CODE_SUB_CATEGORY , FR.RULE_DESCRIPTION , FR.RULE_CONTENTS_N , FR.RULE_CONTENTS , FM.FTA_CODE , FM.FTA_NAME , FR.RULE_SEQ , FR.CTH_RULE , FR.DE_MINIMIS_RATE / 100 DE_MINIMIS_RATE , CASE WHEN FR.BD_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN 'BD' WHEN FR.BU_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN 'BU' WHEN FR.NC_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN 'NC' WHEN FR.FTA_CODE = 'PKRZZ' THEN 'B' -- APTA 일경우 B로 표기 WHEN FR.MC_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN 'MC' ELSE NULL END RVC_CODE , CASE WHEN FR.BD_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.BD_RULE / 100 WHEN FR.BU_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.BU_RULE / 100 WHEN FR.NC_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.NC_RULE / 100 WHEN FR.MC_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.MC_RULE / 100 ELSE NULL END RVC_RATE , FE.EXCLUSION_RULE_DESCRIPTION EXCLUSION_DESCRIPTION FROM FTA_RULE FR LEFT OUTER JOIN FTA_EXCLUSION_RULE FE ON FE.FTA_CODE = FR.FTA_CODE AND FE.HS_CODE = FR.HS_CODE AND FE.RULE_SEQ = FR.RULE_SEQ INNER JOIN HS_CODE HC ON FR.HS_CODE = SUBSTR(HC.HS_CODE, 1, LENGTH(FR.HS_CODE)) INNER JOIN FTA_MASTER FM ON FM.FTA_CODE = FR.FTA_CODE WHERE HC.HS_CODE = #{selHsCode} ORDER BY HC.HS_CODE, FM.FTA_CODE, FR.HS_CODE_SUB_CATEGORY,FR.RULE_SEQ, FR.CTH_RULE
